rationale: Luqman is building AI video generation tools for creators at Neural Studio, while Harris is an agentic engineer at Meta working on AI agents and language model systems. Harris's expertise in AI systems and multilingual applications could inform how agentic capabilities are integrated into creative tools, and Luqman's focus on accessible AI for creators represents a product domain where Harris's agent-building work could have direct application.
intro_message: Luqman Elbakri, meet Harris Warren — Harris builds agentic AI systems at Meta and has deep experience with language models; Luqman is scaling AI video generation tools for creators, and you two could explore how agent-based workflows unlock new creative possibilities.
